turns.content: Write 2-(2-oxopropoxy)acetaldehyde in condensed form and identify its aldehyde and ketone carbonyls.
Treat both carbonyl groups with two equivalents of methylenetriphenylphosphorane. Determine compound A, give its condensed structure, and decide whether it is a monoalkene or a diene.
Verify A's carbon count, connectivity, and number of carbon-carbon double bonds.
Treat A with a Grubbs ruthenium catalyst in benzene. What ring-closing-metathesis product B forms? Give an unambiguous structure or name.
Treat B with ethanol under acid catalysis and determine the final product C by an unambiguous name.
Check that the ring size established in forming B and the regiochemistry established in the final addition are consistent with C.
Report C and briefly connect the structures of A, B, and C.
